provenance: Author supplied collaborator aggregate counts in chat, in the order Rule, Fine-tuned, ALIVE. No trial-level records were supplied.

protocol.control_interface: RGB image -> estimated object pose -> control policy, following the ViserDex-based approach adapted to Revo3
success_requires: orientation error at stop at most 15 degrees

reporting_scope: Descriptive aggregate task completion; 80 trials per method and 240 total. The ball is in the hardware cohort, not an added Q1 simulation object. RGB-D pose recall is a separate simulated perception study, not a hardware estimator ablation.
do_not_infer: a causal contribution of RGB-D to these RGB hardware results
